text: Sequences now support variable duration - each step can have a different length in musical beats
Endless Spinner on the landing page generates infinite sequences automatically
Message read receipts show when your messages were seen
Trails now taper, have richer colors, and render more smoothly
Added help guides to the step editor, sequence viewer, and generator
Sequence transforms can now apply to individual hands
Renamed 'beat' to 'step' throughout the app for clarity
Trail options now hide dual-end tracking for single-ended props
Swipe panels no longer trigger accidental page refresh
Option picker displays correctly on first load on mobile
Help button pointer now points to correct location on all devices
Dashboard sequences display at proper size
Gallery thumbnails are more usable and reliable
New user sign-up flow works correctly on mobile
Loop mode now steps by 2 beats, free form steps by 1
